items.briefing:
A new survey reveals that 84% of Australians believe AI will make cybercrime worse — and that concern is well-founded. Scammers are already using increasingly sophisticated tactics, with Scamwatch continuing to track a high volume of alerts targeting Australians. Separately, a newly discovered security flaw in Cisco products relates to weaknesses in how systems verify user identity, a reminder that business software should always be kept up to date and patched promptly.

On a positive note, new security services are launching across Australia and New Zealand, giving local organisations more options to strengthen their defences.

**Practical tip:** Check with your IT team that all business software — especially network equipment — is running the latest updates.

featured.title: Virtual IT Group launches security services in ANZ
featured.summary: Mid-market firms in Australia and New Zealand can now buy round-the-clock threat monitoring as AI adoption widens security gaps.
